revision_history.title: Pre-event freshness
revision_history.coaching_correction: Saturday's church event remains low-load social/recovery context. Friday rest is now driven primarily by the combined Tuesday and Thursday MTB load.

decision_basis.thursday_session: 110.7 minutes, Garmin load 219.3, RPE 6, aerobic/anaerobic Training Effect 3.9/3.0, and 28.3 minutes in Z4-Z5.
decision_basis.mtb_density: Tuesday plus Thursday produced 496.5 Garmin load across 226.4 minutes with 72.9 minutes in Z4-Z5.
decision_basis.weekly_density: Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday total 512.7 Garmin load, above the planned 280-370 weekly range.
decision_basis.post_ride_state: Readiness 60 yellow, current Body Battery 38, and Garmin ACWR 1.6 high after Thursday's ride.
decision_basis.saturday_context: The church 3.5 km fun run/walk and simple telematch remain athlete-classified low-load social/recovery activity and are a secondary, not primary, reason for Friday rest.

session.title: Post-MTB absorption day
session.purpose: Absorb the combined Tuesday and Thursday MTB stimulus and prevent a third meaningful load from turning productive riding into unrecovered density.

dose.completion: Full rest from planned exercise; normal daily movement only, with no trainer, gym, intervals, trail riding, or compensatory session.

session.adaptation_hypothesis: A full absorption day should preserve the technical gain while allowing autonomic, muscular, and MTB neural cost to fall before the weekend and Hong Kong travel week.
execution_rules: Use normal daily movement only; an easy walk for ordinary life is not a workout.
Prioritize normal meals, carbohydrate restoration, protein distribution, hydration, and sleep.
Do not turn a green-looking Friday Garmin score into permission for training; Thursday's post-session density is the governing constraint.

expected_result.next_day: Improved freshness with no worsening leg, upper-body, or decision-speed fatigue.
expected_result.adaptation: Thursday's riding quality is consolidated rather than diluted by another dose.

stop_rules: Illness symptoms, unusual fatigue, poor coordination, or escalating calf, Achilles, knee, adductor, upper-body, or back symptoms require additional recovery and downshift Saturday participation as needed.
Do not use mobility, walking, or errands as a route into an unplanned workout.
